steps.title: Order
steps.copy: Order through the NHS App, or drop your repeat slip into the box at reception. We do not take orders by phone — it keeps the lines free for people who need to talk to us.

steps.title: We process it
steps.copy: Allow two full working days. Your usual GP reviews anything unusual before it is signed off.

steps.title: Collect
steps.copy: Collect from your nominated pharmacy. You can change your nomination at any time in the NHS App.
